name: Finasteride on cycle

lead: Finasteride on cycle means using a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor (5-ARI) while using testosterone or other androgens, with the aim of reducing hair loss. Testosterone converts to DHT, which contributes to pattern baldness in people predisposed to it, and finasteride lowers that conversion.

The appearance goal is keeping hair thickness and the hairline during a period of increased androgen exposure. Research on finasteride for hair loss is well established, but studies of its use alongside anabolic steroids are lacking.

paras: Users add a prescription 5-ARI alongside a cycle or testosterone therapy, often at the start of the cycle for those worried about hair. Some forum members also discuss it for nandrolone-related sexual side effects.

Finasteride is prescription-only. Reported effects include sexual side effects, and some users report persistent symptoms they call post-finasteride syndrome. Anabolic steroids carry their own risks. Medical supervision is the standard guidance.

chain: Androgen use raises testosterone and DHT
Slower DHT-driven hair thinning; hairline kept
angle.text: Finasteride lowers DHT, the androgen linked to pattern hair loss, so users add it during androgen use to protect hair.

lead: Finasteride on cycle is a bodybuilding and looksmaxxing practice of taking a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor while using androgens, in order to limit hair loss.

5-alpha-reductase converts testosterone into the more potent DHT, and 5-ARIs block this step; finasteride lowers DHT by up to about 70 percent [1]. Because androgen receptor activation contributes to male-pattern baldness, lowering DHT reduces hair loss, and finasteride was approved for this in 1997 [1]. Anabolic steroid pages note that testosterone-to-DHT conversion can speed baldness in the genetically predisposed [2].
On T Nation, users ask whether to run it to protect their hair [3] and discuss it for nandrolone-related effects [4]. Others report adverse events after finasteride and androgen use [5][6].

paras: Finasteride inhibits types 2 and 3 of 5-alpha-reductase, lowering DHT, while testosterone and estradiol levels rise slightly [1]. Dutasteride inhibits all three isoenzymes [1].

On T Nation, a user planning a first cycle with long, thick hair wonders whether to protect it [3], and another recommends a 5-ARI with nandrolone to address "deca dick" [4]. These are community claims.

5-ARIs are generally well tolerated but can cause decreased libido, erectile and ejaculatory dysfunction in roughly 3.4 to 15.8 percent of men, and in a subset these may persist after stopping [1]. Forum users describe symptoms they call post-finasteride syndrome [5][6]. A 2017 cohort found increased depression and self-harm risk in the first 18 months of use, with low absolute risk [1].
No studies found on finasteride combined with anabolic steroids. Registered finasteride trials in the research record concern benign prostatic hyperplasia, a different condition.
